# bigbullui — Full Component & Agent Specification

> Complete catalog of 462 zero-dependency React 19 + Tailwind CSS 4 components with Ticket Stub aesthetic.

## Installation & CLI
```bash
# Add components via zero-dep CLI:
npx bigbullui add <component-name>
# Or install all-in-one package:
npm install bigbullui
```

## Tailwind CSS v4 Setup
```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "bigbullui/css";
```

## Core Architecture Rules
1. Components in `src/components/ui/*` import ONLY `react` and `./lib/utils`.
2. No third-party packages (no Radix, no Lucide, no Framer Motion).
3. All styles use semantic Tailwind tokens (`bg-primary`, `text-muted-foreground`, `border-border`).
4. Keyboard focus rings (`focus-visible:ring-2 ring-ring`) and `motion-reduce` fallbacks are built-in.
